payload.purpose_context: On 2026-11-23 obsidian-sync (Restart=always) restarted 39 times in about 7 minutes after a Node 22 to 24 switch and nothing alerted, because existing monitoring only checks for failed units. This mission closes that blind spot so a restart loop reaches Kent within minutes (kentonium3/kg-automation#1133).
payload.purpose_tldr: Alert when a systemd unit on office2 keeps restarting, even though it never reaches the failed state.

options: A: A curated list - the long-running services in service-inventory.json (obsidian-sync, openclaw-gateway, ollama) plus the docker containers
B (recommended): Every system and user unit that has a restart policy, minus an ignore list
C: Only inventory units that already carry a systemd-status health check
payload.question: When a unit on office2 keeps restarting without ever reaching the failed state, which units should raise an alert?

payload.final_answer: B: Every system and user unit that has a restart policy, plus docker containers, minus an ignore list

options: A: Any increase in NRestarts between two checks
B (recommended): N restarts within a window, global default (e.g. >=3 in 15 min)
C: A per-unit threshold kept in service-inventory.json
payload.question: What restart rate counts as a crash loop?

payload.final_answer: B: N restarts within a window, one global default (e.g. >=3 in 15 min); a single restart does not alert

options: A (recommended): felix-canary, as a new probe method
payload.question: Which existing monitor should own crash-loop detection?

payload.final_answer: A: felix-canary, as a new probe method

options: A (recommended): Within one canary tick (<=15 min), using the persistent restart counter
B: Within 5 min (faster cadence or event-driven hook)
payload.question: How fast must a crash-loop alert land?

payload.final_answer: A: Within one canary tick (<=15 min), using the persistent NRestarts counter

options: A (recommended): Once per loop episode, with a cleared entry after K quiet ticks
B: On every tick while the loop continues
payload.question: Once a crash loop has alerted, when should it alert again or clear?

payload.final_answer: A: Once per loop episode, with a cleared entry after K quiet ticks (matching the canary dedup)
